description: Optional JSON settings for the phase-picking interfaces.

fields.threads: Positive CPU thread count; defaults to 1
fields.window_samples: Model window size; fixed for PhaseNet and EQTransformer
fields.overlap_samples: Overlap used by run_continuous.py; must be smaller than window_samples

precedence: Command-line values override JSON values; model defaults to phasenet.
scope: This config controls inference only. Thresholding and pick extraction remain case-workflow decisions.
